title: +INTRODUCTION TO METEOROLOGY
description: Introduces the physical laws and equations governing the atmosphere, with a focus on understanding why common types of weather occur. Explores weather forecasting, with an emphasis on using weather service data and analysis. Builds knowledge of weather phenomena through the practice of weather forecasting.
